sentences.cn_text: 中产阶级面临的诸多恼人挑战中,有一个在下届总统竞选中恐怕不会被提及:当机器人夺走他们的工作时会发生什么?
sentences.en_text: Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs?

sentences.cn_text: 不要完全否定这种可能性。
sentences.en_text: Don’t dismiss that possibility entirely.

sentences.cn_text: 牛津大学的一项研究显示,美国约一半的工作岗位面临被自动化取代的高风险,中产阶级受到的冲击尤为严重。
sentences.en_text: About half of U.S. jobs are at high risk of being automated, according to a University of Oxford study, with the middle class disproportionately squeezed.

sentences.cn_text: 园艺或日托之类的低收入工作对机器人缺乏吸引力。
sentences.en_text: Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don’t appeal to robots.

sentences.cn_text: 但许多中产阶级职业——如卡车运输、财务咨询、软件工程——已经或即将引起机器人的兴趣。
sentences.en_text: But many middle-class occupations — trucking, financial advice, software engineering — have aroused their interest, or soon will.

sentences.cn_text: 富人拥有机器人,所以他们会安然无恙。
sentences.en_text: The rich own the robots, so they will be fine.

sentences.cn_text: 这并非危言耸听。
sentences.en_text: This isn’t to be alarmist.

sentences.cn_text: 乐观主义者指出,技术变革在过去曾令劳动者受益。
sentences.en_text: Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past.

sentences.cn_text: 工业革命对那些因机械织机而失业的卢德派人士并不友好,但最终它提高了生活水平,创造的就业岗位多于摧毁的岗位。
sentences.en_text: The Industrial Revolution didn’t go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.

sentences.cn_text: 同样,自动化最终应会提高生产率,通过降低价格刺激需求,并使劳动者从艰苦、乏味的工作中解放出来。
sentences.en_text: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work.

sentences.cn_text: 但在中期内,中产阶级劳动者可能需要大量帮助以适应变化。
sentences.en_text: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.

sentences.cn_text: 正如埃里克·布林约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲在《第二次机器时代》中所主张的,第一步应该是重新思考教育和职业培训。
sentences.en_text: The first step, as Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue in The Second Machine Age, should be rethinking education and job training.

sentences.cn_text: 从文法学校到大学的课程设置应该演进,减少对记忆事实的侧重,更多强调创造力和复杂沟通能力。
sentences.en_text: Curriculums — from grammar school to college — should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.

sentences.cn_text: 职业学校应在培养解决问题的能力以及帮助学生与机器人协同工作方面做得更好。
sentences.en_text: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problemsolving skills and helping students work alongside robots.

sentences.cn_text: 在线教育可以补充传统教育。
sentences.en_text: Online education can supplement the traditional kind.

sentences.cn_text: 它可以使额外的培训和教学变得经济实惠。
sentences.en_text: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.

sentences.cn_text: 试图习得新技能的专业人士将能够在不负债的情况下做到这一点。
sentences.en_text: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.

sentences.cn_text: 应对自动化挑战凸显出美国需要重振其日渐衰退的商业活力:必须让创办新企业变得更容易。
sentences.en_text: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.

sentences.cn_text: 在以往技术剧变的时代,企业家通过构想将劳动力与机器结合的方式来平滑过渡。
sentences.en_text: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.

sentences.cn_text: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳应用尚未被发明出来。
sentences.en_text: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven’t been invented yet.

sentences.cn_text: 美国需要那些将发明这些应用的新企业。
sentences.en_text: The U.S. needs the new companies that will invent them.

sentences.cn_text: 最后,由于自动化有可能扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距,税收和社会保障网络将不得不重新考量。
sentences.en_text: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.

sentences.cn_text: 低工资劳动的税负需要削减,劳动所得税抵免等工资补贴应该扩大:这将提高收入,鼓励就业,奖励企业创造就业岗位,并缩小不平等。
sentences.en_text: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.

sentences.cn_text: 技术将在未来几年以大大小小的方式改善社会,但这对那些因自动化而生活和职业生涯被颠覆的人来说,几乎起不到安慰作用。
sentences.en_text: Technology will improve society in ways big and small over the next few years, yet this will be little comfort to those who find their lives and careers upended by automation.

sentences.cn_text: 摧毁那些将夺走我们工作的机器是愚蠢的行为。
sentences.en_text: Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts.

sentences.cn_text: 但帮助劳动者适应的政策将是不可或缺的。
sentences.en_text: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.

sentences.cn_text: 谁将受到自动化的最大威胁?
sentences.en_text: Who will be most threatened by automation?

sentences.cn_text: 主要政治人物。
sentences.en_text: Leading politicians.

sentences.cn_text: 低工资劳动者。
sentences.en_text: Low-wage laborers.

sentences.cn_text: 机器人所有者。
sentences.en_text: Robot owners.

sentences.cn_text: 中产阶级劳动者。
sentences.en_text: Middle-class workers.

sentences.cn_text: 以下哪项最能代表作者的观点?
sentences.en_text: Which of the following best represents the author’s view?

sentences.cn_text: 对自动化的担忧实际上毫无根据。
sentences.en_text: Worries about automation are in fact groundless.

sentences.cn_text: 乐观主义者对新技术的看法缺乏支持。
sentences.en_text: Optimists’ opinions on new tech find little support.

sentences.cn_text: 自动化引发的问题需要解决。
sentences.en_text: Issues arising from automation need to be tackled.

sentences.cn_text: 新技术的负面后果可以避免。
sentences.en_text: Negative consequences of new tech can be avoided.

sentences.cn_text: 自动化时代的教育应更加注重____。
sentences.en_text: Education in the age of automation should put more emphasis on ____

sentences.cn_text: 创造潜能。
sentences.en_text: creative potential.

sentences.cn_text: 求职技能。
sentences.en_text: job-hunting skills.

sentences.cn_text: 个体需求。
sentences.en_text: individual needs.

sentences.cn_text: 合作精神。
sentences.en_text: cooperative spirit.

sentences.cn_text: 作者建议税收政策应以____为目标。
sentences.en_text: The author suggests that tax policies be aimed at ____

sentences.cn_text: 鼓励自动化的发展。
sentences.en_text: encouraging the development of automation.

sentences.cn_text: 提高资本投资回报。
sentences.en_text: increasing the return on capital investment.

sentences.cn_text: 缓解贫富之间的对立。
sentences.en_text: easing the hostility between rich and poor.

sentences.cn_text: 防止收入差距扩大。
sentences.en_text: preventing the income gap from widening.

sentences.cn_text: 在本文中,作者提出了一个问题并给出____。
sentences.en_text: In this text, the author presents a problem with ____

sentences.cn_text: 对立的观点。
sentences.en_text: opposing views on it.

sentences.cn_text: 可能的解决方案。
sentences.en_text: possible solutions to it.

sentences.cn_text: 令人担忧的影响。
sentences.en_text: its alarming impacts.

sentences.cn_text: 主要的变化形式。
sentences.en_text: its major variations.
